prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. PRODUCTION KEY DRAWINGS for an actual 2D sprite animation of the EXACT mushroom nest in the two references. Image1 is approved level3; Image2 is approved level4 aligned to the same ground. Create ONE transparent RGBA sheet, a strict 2 columns by 2 rows grid of FOUR complete separate key poses. Each cell has the SAME square coordinate system, camera, lighting, pixel scale, ground center and generous transparent 10% margin. No text, borders, shadows, labels, motion streaks or decorative effects. Match the polished painterly coral-red cap, creamy ivory organic tissue, red eggs, dark teal thin contour, wood and warm brass precisely. Four anatomical poses of the same nest, not redesigns.
TOP LEFT: exact LEVEL3 CLOSED, at t1.40: cap compresses down very modestly, neck gently compresses. The TWO broad FRONT ivory cradle lips have folded inward and UP to meet in the middle as two plump upright lobes, fully sealing the opening. All three eggs are entirely inside and occluded, none visible. Keep the rear bowl and cap at level3 size and the original vents, wood posts, wood collar and right wooden bellows intact and connected.
TOP RIGHT: t2.20 FOUNDATION assembly, same CLOSED level3 organic body lifted a little higher, resting on the partly assembled burgundy and ivory level4 circular base. Front ivory steps opened halfway at their hinges, left and right base segments sliding together. Original wooden machinery still present. Do not grow the whole nest uniformly. The two closed front lobes remain joined, no eggs visible. Cap and body retain coherent outlines.
BOTTOM LEFT: t2.60 MID-GROWTH, a real intermediate anatomy between the two references: medium-height cream neck, slightly narrower and higher coral cap halfway toward level4, still CLOSED front lips. The ivory nesting bowl grows upward from the assembled burgundy platform. Wooden collar is being physically encased by two hinged brass half-shells, short sections of ivory-and-brass side columns rising from the base but not yet attached to cap. Right wood bellows folds inward behind the bowl. No visible eggs, no see-through tissue, no melting metal. One coherent body, intact firm joints.
BOTTOM RIGHT: exact LEVEL4 CLOSED at t3.60, all final ivory columns, brass collar, vents, turquoise right pressure tank, wheel and burgundy stepped base assembled exactly like reference2. Only change from reference2 is the sealed front ivory lips concealing all eggs and a very slight cap lowering. The two closed ivory lobes retain rounded volume and meet without holes. No egg opening visible.
These are source drawings to extract real anatomy and hidden-surface pieces for rigging. All mechanical parts retain rigid solid shapes, no chopped columns, no detached chips, no duplicated machinery. Preserve the exact visual identity, original framing and perspective in every cell. Genuine transparent background.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Real production cutout-animation source layers. The first two images lock the level3 and level4 mushroom designs. Image3 supplies the approved sealed-front anatomical pose. Draw ONE transparent RGBA atlas in a STRICT FOUR columns by THREE rows grid, exactly TWELVE completely separate objects, large clean transparent gutters and 12% empty margin in each cell. Landscape high-detail sheet. Same front three-quarter camera, warm upper-left light, coral red and creamy ivory painterly tissue, fine dark teal outlines. NO labels, text, background, ground shadows, complete buildings, pipes, machinery, wooden collars or metal anywhere in these organic parts.
ROW1 four separate LEVEL3 parts, left to right:
(1) COMPLETE BARE cream STEM with its REAR nesting bowl as one connected organic body. Remove the ENTIRE front lip and both front cheek lobes: low cutaway open front, unobstructed empty ivory concave bowl floor, full rounded top of neck with hidden tissue painted. No eggs, cap, posts or hardware. No two large cheek shapes on its front.
(2) ONLY level3 OPEN FRONT LIP, one continuous wide low U-shaped ivory strip with broad rounded outward side lobes and a narrow low connecting center. Transparent U opening above it. Nothing behind the strip, no bowl, stem or eggs.
(3) ONLY the SAME level3 FRONT LIP FULLY CLOSED as the two plump upright lobes meeting at center in image3 top-left. One connected ivory object with complete hidden bottom, no central hole and no body behind it.
(4) COMPLETE level3 CORAL MUSHROOM CAP ALONE, with full scalloped skirt, gills and hidden undersides drawn behind where the old vents/wood were. No vents, wood, collar or cream neck attached.
ROW2 four separate MID-GROWTH parts:
(1) BARE cream stem and REAR nesting bowl, intermediate between level3 and level4, slightly taller smooth neck and slightly narrower nesting bowl. Same cutaway low open front with no cheek lobes and an unobstructed empty bowl floor, no hardware or cap.
(2) MID-GROWTH CLOSED front lip only, the two upright ivory lobes joined at center, midway in width and shape between row1 closed lips and row3 closed lips, no other tissue attached.
(3) MID-GROWTH coral cap alone, midway in width, height and scalloped skirt shape between the two reference caps. Full hidden underside, no hardware or neck.
(4) ONE complete plump coral-red EGG matching the three eggs in the references, rounded full lower contour, shiny upper-left highlight, nothing else.
ROW3 four separate LEVEL4 parts:
(1) BARE cream stem and REAR nesting bowl, smooth taller neck and coral-red upholstered rear concave bowl, low cutaway open front and unobstructed red bowl floor. NO front white cheek lobes, no front white lip, no gold collar or rim, no eggs, no cap or machinery. Complete hidden organic tissue under collars.
(2) ONLY level4 OPEN FRONT ivory LIP, matching reference2: continuous low U-shaped strip with large rounded outward side lobes and narrow low center bridge. Transparent U interior, no gold, eggs, stem, bowl or other layers attached.
(3) ONLY level4 FULLY CLOSED ivory FRONT LIP with two plump upright lobes joined at center exactly like image3 bottom-right. No red bowl opening, no gold, no eggs, no body or machinery behind it.
(4) COMPLETE level4 coral mushroom CAP ALONE, full scalloped hidden underside and gills. Remove all vents, metal fittings, supports and neck.
Maintain twelve clean independent opaque painted parts with genuine clean alpha edges. Draw complete hidden contour surfaces and rounded bases, no chopped joints. These exact parts will be animated, not used as a concept preview.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Production hidden-surface source art for layered animation. Draw exactly THREE separate BARE mushroom BACK-BODIES, left to right, on a perfectly clean truly transparent background with zero haze, zero drop shadow and zero backdrop pixels. The references show complete nests only to lock anatomy and materials. Extract/reconstruct ONLY the rear cream stem and BACK HALF of the nesting bowl as a single piece in each object. NO mushroom cap, no hardware, no vents, no wood, no gold, no eggs. CRITICAL: remove the ENTIRE FRONT HALF of the bowl: NO front lip, NO front wall, NO large ivory cheek ovals, NO U-shaped strip, NO front rounded lobes. It is an anatomical CUTAWAY: front edge is a very low simple continuous cut edge exposing the bowl's unobstructed concave interior floor. The rear wall is visible behind. Draw the formerly hidden stem from rounded top to the rear bowl, one connected complete piece, same polished game style and front three-quarter camera. LEFT: level3 bare short flared cream neck with broad rear bowl and entirely IVORY interior. CENTER: transitional medium neck and medium-width rear bowl, mostly IVORY interior with a thin coral rear lining starting only near the back. RIGHT: level4 taller bare cream neck and narrower rear bowl with CORAL-RED interior upholstery on its rear wall and floor. NONE of the three has the two plump front ivory cheeks seen in the complete nest references. Those moving front pieces will be separate attachments. Complete tissue behind the missing neck collar and side fittings. All three objects have the same view and matching warm ivory/coral shading and fine dark teal outline. Generous transparent gaps, no letters, no full nests, no extras. The low cutaway edge must make it impossible to mistake these for complete front-enclosed bowls.
